The company was formerly known as Bihar Tubes Limited and changed its name to APL Apollo Tubes Limited in 2010. APL Apollo Tubes Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited
summary: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited, an integrated pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, markets, and sells pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. The company provides products in various therapeutic areas, such as cardiology, orthopaedics, anti-diabetic, ophthalmology, gynaecology, nephrology, gastrology, urology, dermatology, anti-infective, cold and cough, and animal health; generics formulations in oral solids, oncology oral solids and injectables, general injectables and ophthalmic products, dermatology, and oral suspension; and active pharmaceutical ingredients. It also exports its products. Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited was founded in 1907 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.

name: Apollo Micro Systems Limited
summary: Apollo Micro Systems Limited designs, develops, and assembles electronic and electromechanical solutions in India. The company offers actuation systems, AI engines, avionics, avionic bus products, automated test equipment, communication systems, composite systems, ground support equipment, navigation systems, power supply systems, RF systems, satellite data handling, sonar systems, telemetry, and warhead and propulsion systems. It also provides hardware and software design, manufacturing, environmental testing, and inertial system calibration services, as well as electronic and mechanical CAD services. Apollo Micro Systems Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

name: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited
summary: Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides healthcare services in India. It operates through Healthcare Services, Retail Health & Diagnostics, Digital Health & Pharmacy Distribution, and Others segments. The company's healthcare facilities comprise primary, secondary, and tertiary care, as well as specialty facilities. It offers services in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastroenterology, orthopedics, urology, organ transplantation, pulmonology, obstetrics and gynecology, internal medicine, vascular surgery, pediatrics, cosmetology, emergency medicine, bariatric surgery, general surgery, colorectal surgery, dentistry, nephrology, dermatology, endocrinology, preventive medicine, interventional radiology, ophthalmology, and integrative medicine, as well as robotic surgery and genomics. The company also provides project consultancy, medical educational institutes, Medvarsity for e-learning, and research services, as well as acts as an agent for life, general, and health insurance. In addition, it operates hospitals, pharmacies, primary care clinics, and diagnostic centers; short stay facilities, boutique birthing centers, multi-specialty clinics, dental and dialysis facilities, and preventive care; day surgery, diabetes management, and cradle and fertility centers; and Apollo 24/7, a digital health mobile platform that provides teleconsultations, online pharmacy deliveries, home diagnostics, and insurance services. Further, the company engages in the business of bio-banking of tissues. It serves patients, corporate clients, and the government and public sectors. Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Chennai, India.

name: Apollo Pipes Limited
summary: Apollo Pipes Limited manufactures and trades in polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pipes and fittings in India. The company offers cPVC, uPVC, and PPR-C plumbing systems; uPVC pressure pipes and fittings, and garden pipes; HDPE PLB duct pipes and MDPE and HDPE gas piping system; SWR drainage system, underground drainage system, and DWC pipes; and agri pipes and fitting, HDPE pipes, coils, and sprinkler systems. It also provides underground drainage uPVC column Pipes, and casing pipes; water tanks, solvent cement, and kitchen sink. In addition, the company offers bath fittings, which include faucets, showers, health faucets, cistern, seat covers, accessories, and allied products. It provides its products to plumbing, agriculture, sewerage, water management, construction, fenestration industry, infrastructure, borewell system solutions, water storage solutions, water supply solutions, bath fittings solutions, industrial piping solutions, and telecom ducting industries. Apollo Pipes Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Noida, India.

name: Apollo Tyres Limited
summary: Apollo Tyres Limited manufactures and sells automotive tires, tubes, and flaps in India and internationally. It offers tires for commercial and passenger vehicles, two-wheelers, trucks and buses, off-highway vehicles, light trucks, earthmovers, and bicycles, as well as for agricultural, farm, and industrial applications. The company provides its products under the Apollo Tyres and Vredestein Tyres brands. Apollo Tyres Limited was incorporated in 1972 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India.

name: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited
summary: Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited operates as a hospitality service management and support services company in India. It offers catering services to corporates, institutions, hospitals, and industries; and kitchen planning and management services. The company also manages food outlets at hospitals and organizations. In addition, it offers outdoor catering services and skilled manpower to hospitals, as well as engages in the business of clinical nutrition, facilities management, and outsourcing services. The company provides its services under The Sketch, Café Canvas, Runaway vegetables, and Sugar Monster brands. Apollo Sindoori Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Chennai, India.

name: Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited
summary: Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited engages in the trading in shares in India. The company invests in equity, debentures, bond, mutual funds, etc. It also offers financial and derivative services; and engages in investment activities. Apoorva Leasing Finance and Investment Company Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Noida, India.

name: Aptech Limited
summary: Aptech Limited operates as a learning solutions company in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Retail and Institutional. The company offers specialized courses in animation, VFX, game design, broadcast, and digital design, as well as filmmaking; courses in cosmetology, makeup, hair styling, skin care, and personal grooming for careers in the fashion, beauty, and wellness industry; and job-oriented courses in aviation, hospitality, travel and tourism, event management, and luxury retail. It also provides IT courses, such as software development, hardware and networking, AI and ML, and cybersecurity; media and entertainment training; testing and assessment services for government, corporate, and institutions; and training in emerging technologies, leadership, communication, and finance; on-campus and online instructor-led and job-focused training programs; hardware and networking courses; and English language programs. In addition, the company operates a preschool chain. It offers its products under the Arena Animation, Maya Academy of Advanced Creativity, Lakme Academy, Avalon Academy, Aptech Learning, The Virtual Production Academy, Aptech International Preschool, Aptech Assessment & Testing Solutions, Aptech Training Solutions, Education Institutes and Corporates (EIC) Unit, Aptech Computer Education, Aptech Hardware & Networking Academy, and Aptech English Learning Academy brand names. Aptech Limited was founded in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited
summary: Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited, together with its subsidiary, Aptus Finance India Private Limited, provides housing finance solutions against immovable properties in India. The company offers home and quasi-home loans for the purchase, construction, renovation, and extension of houses; loans against property for construction and purchase of houses; and secured, small business, and refinance loans. It serves shopkeepers, vendors mechanics, and traders; and semi-urban families rural households markets. Aptus Value Housing Finance India Limited was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Chennai, India.

name: Aqylon Nexus Limited
summary: Aqylon Nexus Limited provides AI data centers, semiconductors, and AI technology services in India and internationally. The company development and operation of ai-ready data centre infrastructure; computing and accelerated computing infrastructure; data storage, networking and related infrastructure; semiconductor design and related technology solutions; machine learning and data engineering services; AI-enabled enterprise automation; cybersecurity and AI infrastructure security; Managed technology and cloud services; and Strategic partnerships with technology, infrastructure and semiconductor ecosystem participants. It serves aerospace, agriculture, telecommunications, and industrial automation sectors. The company was formerly known as Sri Adhikari Brothers Television Network Limited and changed its name to Aqylon Nexus Limited in January 2026. Aqylon Nexus Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Archidply Industries Limited
summary: Archidply Industries Limited manufactures and sells wood and paper-based products in India and internationally. It operates through Plywood & Allied Products, Laminate & Allied Products, and Medium Density Fibre Board segments. The company offers plywood; flush and laminated doors; densified film face plywood; clads; interior grade, unicore, digital, and sandwich compacts; insulator panels and paper phenolic laminates; extreme density high moisture resistance plain and laminated products; PVC, WPC, and hybrid WPC boards; and medium density fiberboards, including interior grade, exterior grade, and pre lam. It also provides exterior grade, high pressure, postforming, ani-fingerprint, anti-bacterial, magnetic, digital, unicore, fire retardant, marker board, chalk board, switch board, and liner laminates. The company was founded in 1976 and is based in New Delhi, India.

name: Archies Limited
summary: Archies Limited engages in dealing in greeting cards, gifts, and stationery products in India and internationally. It operates through Greeting Cards; Stationery and Paper Bag Items; Gifts; and Others segments. The company offers birthday, daughters day, new, and anniversary products; jewellery and accessories, including necklaces, earrings, bracelets, anklets, keychain, tote bags, ladies bags and wallets, mens wallet, and mens fashion accessories; personalized cards, photoframes, and occasional products; and gift products, such as mugs, showpiece, soft toys, photo album and frame, clock hanging, candle, water bottles and flasks, trophy, pen stand, wind chime quotation gifts and decor, glassware and bar accessories, artificial flowers, and card cases, as well as elephant parade, LED gifts collection, home décor, corporate gifts, evil eye charms, kids collection, divine idols and gifts, Desi Archies, AMA merchandise, new born keepsakes, and chocolates and sweets. It also provides greeting cards for celebrations, expressions, occasions, and personalized; same day delivery products; perfumes and fragrances gift sets; and notebook, diary, quotation book, collectible, scrap book, back to school, shagun envelope, calendar, paper bags, and scroll. It sells its products under the Archies, IK YK, Parker, Luxor, Flair, Submarine, and Pierre Cardin brand through a distribution network comprising company owned stores, franchisees, distributors, and retailers, as well as through online websites, marketplaces, and quick commerce platforms. The company also exports its products to the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, the Netherlands, Oman, and Nepal. Archies Limited was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

name: ASSET RECONSTRUC CO (I) L
summary: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited operates as an asset reconstruction company, acquiring and resolving distressed assets and non-performing loans. The company acquires, manages, and resolves stressed assets across corporate, SME, and retail segments, providing asset reconstruction services that include acquisition of non-performing assets, restructuring, settlement, and sale of assets. It conducts property auctions, manages settlement processes related to distressed assets, and engages in insolvency and bankruptcy resolution processes under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016, in partnership with insolvency professionals and legal firms. The company also undertakes corporate social responsibility initiatives focused on education, vocational skills, livelihood enhancement, and environmental sustainability. The company serves corporate, SME, and retail clients with stressed assets, as well as banks, non-banking financial companies, legal professionals, advocates, and law firms involved in asset recovery and insolvency processes. The company was founded in 2002 and is based in Mumbai, India. Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited operates as a subsidiary of Avenue India Resurgence Pte Limited.

name: ARCL Organics Ltd.
summary: ARCL Organics Ltd. manufactures and sells resins, additives, hardeners, and specialized one-shot resins in India. The company offers amino and melamine resins, phenolic resins, and formaldehydes. It serves panel, animal feed, rubber, pharma, engineering, textile, paper, foundries, refractories, paints, tire, and various other industries. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries. The company was formerly known as AAREM Chemicals (P) Ltd. and changed its name to ARCL Organics Ltd. in April 2011. ARCL Organics Ltd. was founded in 1959 and is based in Kolkata, India.

name: Ardee Industries Limited
summary: Ardee Industries Limited engages in the recovery and recycling of end-of-life energy storage products and non-ferrous scrap while claiming resources from waste streams. The company's products include pure lead and lead alloys comprising lead calcium, lead antimony, lead tin, lead silver, and lead cadmium alloys that applies in energy storage, e-mobility, automotive, chemical, and other industries. It operates in India, Singapore, Hong Kong, South Korea, Switzerland, United Arab Emirates, Japan, Saudi Arabia, and United States of America. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is based in New Delhi, India.

name: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited
summary: Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells lead-acid storage batteries for industrial and automotive applications in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Lead Acid Batteries and Allied Products; and New Energy Business. The company provides new energy business related products; installation, commissioning, and maintenance services; and industrial chargers, integrated power systems, electric charging solutions, and battery energy storage systems, as well as lithium-based home UPS systems and hybrid inverter platforms for residential and small commercial applications. It also develops, manufactures, and sells energy storage and management products, solutions, and technologies related to lithium cells, advanced cell chemistries, battery packs, and components. The company sells its batteries under the Amaron, PowerZone, Power Stack, AmaronVolt, Amaron Brute, Amaron Sleek, ELITO, and Quanta brands. The company supplies its batteries to various customer groups, such as telecom, railways, solar, motive, power control, international operations, defence, and UPS; and automobile original equipment manufacturers, replacement markets, and private label customers. The company was formerly known as Amara Raja Batteries Limited and changed its name to Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited in September 2023. Amara Raja Energy & Mobility Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

name: Rajdarshan Industries Limited
summary: Rajdarshan Industries Limited trades in quartz grit and powder, and consumables n commission basis in India. It is also involved in the project management, marketing consultancy, limestone, cement plant, marble and mines machine activities, as well as trading in minerals. The company was formerly known as A.R. Enterprises Limited. Rajdarshan Industries Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in Udaipur, India.

name: Arfin India Limited
summary: Arfin India Limited manufactures and trades in ferrous and non-ferrous metals in India. Its products include conductor and cables, aluminum wire rods, cored wire, ferro alloys, inoculant, aluminum deox, and aluminum alloys ingots. It serves electrical transmission and distribution, steel, foundry, construction, packaging, and infrastructure industries. The company also exports its products. Arfin India Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.

name: Aries Agro Limited
summary: Aries Agro Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing and sale of micronutrients and other nutritional products for plants and animals. The company offers micronutrients, water soluble NPK, organic and bio products, high density inputs, crop specific, slow release fertilizers pastilles, plant protection, aqua culture and animal nutrition, urban products, and other products. It also provides various crops, such as sugarcane, grape, coffee, cotton, potato, cauliflower, citrus, cashew nut, papaya, wheat, cocoa, paddy, turmeric, elephant yam, oil palm, black gram, tomato, pomegranate, rose, mango, maize, onion, ginger, chilli, banana, watermelon, and groundnut. In addition, the company is involved in farm equipment and machinery, and mineral feed supplements businesses; and trading of plant nutrients. It has operations in India, Australia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Nepal, the Philippines, Taiwan, the United Arab Emirates, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia, Mozambique, Uzbekistan, Bangladesh, Mauritius, and internationally. Aries Agro Limited was incorporated in 1969 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited
summary: Arihant Foundations & Housing Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development and related activities in India. It is involved in the construction of residential and commercial complexes and IT parks. The company was founded in 1984 and is based in Chennai, India.

name: Arihant Capital Markets Limited
summary: Arihant Capital Markets Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the broking and related businesses in India. The company offers stock, commodities, and insurance broking services, as well as portfolio management, financial, real estate, and other related services. It is also involved in the retail broking, and depository services; Serving banks, insurance companies, mutual funds, and other institutions; mobile, web and desktop trading platforms for equities, ETFs, derivatives, IPOs, NCDs, commodities, and currencies; capital markets services, corporate finance, strategic advisory services, valuation, and specialized services; and mutual funds, fixed income, bonds, and NPS distribution services. In addition, the company provides NBFC and MTF loan against shares, and margin trading funding services; portfolio management services; and investment across asset classes, and platforms. It serves retail customers, mutual funds and financial institutions, and corporate clients. Arihant Capital Markets Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Indore, India.

name: Arihant Superstructures Limited
summary: Arihant Superstructures Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. The company develops residential properties, including residences, villas, hospitality and mixed-use developments, and apartments. The company was formerly known as Shaktiman Constructions Limited and changed its name to Arihant Superstructures Limited in August 2009. Arihant Superstructures Limited was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

name: Arisinfra Solutions Limited
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the trading, procuring, supplying, and distributing of raw materials for the creation of infrastructure, buildings, and construction in India. Its product portfolio includes aggregates, ready-mix concrete, walling, construction, chemicals, steel, cement, tiles, electricals, plumbing and other allied construction materials solutions. The company's solutions enable developers, EPC contractors, infrastructure players, manufacturers and other institutional customers to procure construction materials. The company was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Arkade Developers Limited
summary: Arkade Developers Limited operates as a real estate development company in India. It engages in the identification and acquisition of land, as well as the planning, execution, construction, and marketing of commercial and residential projects. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Arman Financial Services Limited
summary: Arman Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiary, operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company offers micro, small, and medium enterprise loans; two wheeler financing for motorcycles, mopeds, scooterettes, and scooters; and micro finance loans, as well as individual business loans and loan against property. The company was formerly known as Arman Lease and Finance Limited and changed its name to Arman Financial Services Limited in November 2008. Arman Financial Services Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: ArMee Infotech Limited
summary: ArMee Infotech Limited provides IT Infrastructure solutions and IT managed services for Government, PSUs, BFSI, education, and private sectors in India. It offers IT Infrastructure products, such as computers, servers, interactive panels and their peripherals; IT managed services, installation and integration of IT hardware and software products; Renewable Energy Space, such as renewable energy EPC services, renewable energy Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) services, renewable energy Battery Energy Storage System (BESS); and experience zones, engages in selling IT hardware and consumer goods, including computers and computer peripherals, consumer electricals, gaming products, and electronics. It also offers cyber-security solutions, including firewall, antivirus, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and encryption services; technical manpower; skill development training; annual maintenance services onsite and off-site operational support; and IT infrastructure maintenance services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Aro Granite Industries Limited
summary: Aro Granite Industries Limited engages in the manufacturing and trading of polished/flamed granite tiles and slabs in India. It offers natural stone granite slabs and granite tiles; and engineered quartz stone slabs for construction, home renovation, wall panelling, countertops, flooring, interior surfaces, and architectural installations. The company also exports its products to approximately 50 countries, including the United States, Canada, Europe, Japan, the Far East, and South Pacific countries. Aro Granite Industries Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Hosur, India.

name: Arrow Greentech Limited
summary: Arrow Greentech Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and sale of green products in India and internationally. It operates in two segments, Green Products and High-Tech Products. The company offers water-soluble films, bio-compostable products, and other green products; and water-soluble laundry capsules, packaging, mold release, water transfer printing, water-soluble embroidery backing, and water-soluble seed tape films, as well as water-soluble laundry bags for agrochemicals and specialty chemicals packaging, construction fibers and chemicals packaging, textile processing, consumer goods and home care chemicals unit dose packaging, and medical and hygiene applications. It also provides BIOPLAST 105 and BIOPLAST GS 2189, a thermoplastic and transparent material that contains high portion of biologically sourced raw materials; and BIOPLAST GF 106/02, a thermoplastic material that contains natural potato starch. In addition, the company offers anti-counterfeit, intellectual property, and security based products, as well as pharmaceutical products; and deals in hightech products and services. Arrow Greentech Limited was formerly known as Arrow Coated Products Limited and changed its name to Arrow Greentech Limited in May 2016. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited
summary: Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited provides stock brokerage services in India and internationally. The company offers equities, derivatives, alternative investment funds, IPOs, mutual funds, portfolio management services, investment basket, margin trading facility, NRI investing, commodities, currencies, fixed income, and insurance products. It also provides TradeMobi, an online app for trading and account related services; TradeXpress, a web-based platform to execute trades and access real-time market data; AR Invest; and Algozy for algorithmic trading strategies. The company was formerly known as Navratan Capital and Securities Limited and changed its name to Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited in January 2008. Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India. Anand Rathi Share and Stock Brokers Limited operates as a subsidiary of Anand Rathi Financial Services Limited.

name: Artemis Medicare Services Limited
summary: Artemis Medicare Services Limited engages in the management and operation of multi-specialty hospitals in India and internationally. The company provides medical and surgical intervention, mix of inpatient and outpatient services. It also offers billing and insurance, childcare, emotional and support program, full body checkup, international patient, medical interpreter and record, mind body medicine, nursing, nutrition, patient and family advisory, patient advocacy and portal, pre-admission testing, and smoking cessation program services, as well as home care services. Artemis Medicare Services Limited was incorporated in 2004 and is based in Gurugram, India.

name: Art Nirman Limited
summary: Art Nirman Limited engages in the real estate development and allied activities in India. The company is involved in the construction and development of residential, commercial, and plotting projects. It also engages in the construction and development of office spaces, showrooms, and shops. In addition, it offers maintenance services. The company was formerly known as Vishnudhara Buildcon Private Limited and changed its name to Art Nirman Limited in October 2011. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Arvee Laboratories (India) Ltd.
summary: Arvee Laboratories (India) Ltd. manufactures and sells various specialized chemicals in India. The company offers polymer modifiers, including dimethyl 5-sodiosulfoisophthalate, 5-sulfoisophthalic acid mono sodium salt, 5-sulfoisophthalic acid mono lithium salt, and 5-sodiosulfo-bis-(ß-hydroxyethyl)-isophthalate; and contrast media intermediates, such as 5-nitroisophthalic acid, dimethyl 5-nitroisophthalate, monomethyl 5-nitroisophthalate, 5-hydroxyisophthalic acid, 5-aminoisophthalic acid, and dimethyl 5-aminoisophthalate, as well as 3,5-dinitrobenzoic acid and 3,5-diamino benzoic acid. It also provides drug intermediates comprising 2-acetyl thiophene, thiophene-2-carboxaldehyde, 4amino pyridine, and 2chloro5nitrobenzoic acid. In addition, the company exports its products. Arvee Laboratories (India) Ltd. was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Arvind Limited
summary: Arvind Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures, markets, retails, supplies, and exports textiles in India and internationally. The company operates through Textiles, Advanced Material, and Others segments. It offers denim fabrics, woven and knitted fabrics, home linens, and voiles and garments products, as well as ready-to-wear apparel and custom tailoring. The company also designs and manufactures flame-retardant fabrics, high-visibility workwear, functional uniforms, and defence-grade protective gear outfits; customised material solutions engineered for industrial environments; hot-gas and liquid filtration products; automotive interiors and seating solutions; and composites and coated fabrics. In addition, it offers water treatment, industrial waste water, and sewage treatment solutions for industries, as well as zero liquid discharge solutions. Further, the company is involved in the EPABX and one to many radio solutions; and building residential, construction contracts, and other activities. Arvind Limited was founded in 1897 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Arvind Fashions Limited
summary: Arvind Fashions Limited engages in the wholesale and retail trading of ready-made garments and accessories in India and internationally. The company offers a portfolio of owned and licensed international brands, such as US Polo, Arrow, Tommy Hilfiger, Flying Machine, Calvin Klein, and others. It also provides footwear and accessories, including belts, bags, etc. It sells its menswear, womenswear, and kids wear products through retail and departmental stores, brand outlets, and e-commerce platforms. The company was formerly known as Arvind J&M Limited. Arvind Fashions Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

name: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited
summary: Arvind SmartSpaces Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development of real estate projects in India. The company develops residential, commercial, industrial projects, villa townships, apartments, plotted developments and villas, commercial spaces, and industrial parks. It serves individual retail clients and corporate entities. The company was formerly known as Arvind Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Arvind SmartSpaces Limited in November 2016. Arvind SmartSpaces Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Aryaman Financial Services Limited
summary: Aryaman Financial Services Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides merchant banking services in India. The company is involved in the lead management and syndication of small and medium sized initial public offerings, follow-on public offerings, rights issues, composite issues, qualified institutional placements, preferential issues, foreign currency convertible bonds, American and global depositary receipts issues, private investment in public equity transactions, venture capital funding, and other types of fundraising. It also provides loan syndication and underwriting; M&A advisory, including buy-side and sell-side advisory services; and open offer management services. In addition, the company offers private equity advisory services; structured finance advisory services, including promoter and acquisition financing; and corporate finance advisory services, such as scheme of amalgamations, mergers, spin-off transactions, ESOP transactions, foreign remittance, and equity placements, etc.; and certification, opinion, and valuation services. Further, it offers stock and commodity broking services; and valuation and advisory services for foreign investments. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India. Aryaman Financial Services Limited is a subsidiary of Mahshri Enterprises Pvt. Ltd.

name: Asahi India Glass Limited
summary: Asahi India Glass Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells glass products in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Automotive Glass and Float Glass. The company offers automotive glass products, including laminated glass for car windscreens; tempered glass for sidelites, backlites, and car windscreens; sunroof solutions; sub-assemblies; value-added glass products; and white goods. It also provides architectural glass products comprising annealed, decorative, float, processed, fire-resistant, energy-efficient, window, and designer glass products, as well as coated glass products for exteriors and interiors. In addition, the company offers consumer glass products for doors, windows, staircases, balustrades, canopies, and infinity pools; and industrial glass products for consumer durables, and construction and farm equipment. Further, it provides automotive glass repair and replacement services, as well as sunroof glass replacement services; and professional car care services comprising battery check and replacement, car detailing and headlight restoration, wiper blade and replacement, and car care product services. The company serves the automotive sector comprising auto manufacturers OEMs, after market, and car owners; building and construction segment consisting of influencers, developers, fabricators/processors, and government/industrial; consumer and trader sector, such as residential, commercial, and dealers and distributors; and industrial sector, including white goods OEMs, and construction and farm equipment. It exports its products. Asahi India Glass Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Gurugram, India.

name: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited
summary: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited manufactures and sells color pigments and derivatives in India. The company offers copper phthalocyanine (CPC) blue crude, pigment alpha, pigment blue, and pigment beta blue. Its products are used in coatings, paints, printing inks, plastics, pharmaceuticals, textiles, rubber, and paper industries. The company also exports its products. Asahi Songwon Colors Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited
summary: Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited designs, develops, manufactures, assembles, and sells sheet metal stampings, welded assemblies, and modules for passenger and commercial vehicles, and tractors in India. The company offers skin panels, including panel front doors, RH and LH side panel outers, assembly front panel and side wall outers, front cabin shields, assembly front bumpers, and assembly outer tail gates; and body in white components comprising assembly body side inners, assembly panel planum, assembly panel dash, assembly cabin rear walls, assembly fire walls, rail under bodies, and assembly reinf hinge pillars and rear quarters, as well as cabin floors. It also provides assy oil sumps; assembly fuel tanks; and suspension products, which include assembly cross members, assy rear suspension modules, assy semi trailing arms, and front suspension modules. The company was formerly known as JBM Tools Limited and changed its name to Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited in August 2003. Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Pune, India. Automotive Stampings and Assemblies Limited operates as a subsidiary of Tata AutoComp Systems Limited.

name: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited
summary: Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited engages in liquor manufacturing, distillation, and bottling activities in India and internationally. It operates through two segments, Potable Alcohols and Ethanol. The company offers extra neutral alcohol, grain-based ethanol, and malt spirit manufacturing, as well as Indian Made Indian Liquor and Indian Made Foreign Liquor. It also provides beers, spirits, wine, whisky, vodka, rum, gin, tequila, brandy, and other products. The company's brands include Central Province Superior Grain Whisky, Nicobar Gin, Titanium Vodka Orange, Titanium Vodka Apple, Titanium Vodka Pure, Hillfort Premium Whisky, Central Province Vodka Orange, Central Province Vodka Apple, Central Province Vodka Ultra Plan, Central Province Whisky, Central Province Rum, James Mc Gill Whisky, James Mc Gill Brandy, Lemount Golden Brandy, Lemount White Brandy, Lemount Black Rum, Mood Maker Brandy, Jamaican Magic Rum, Bombay Special Whisky, Superman Fine Whisky, Desi Madira Masala, and Titanium Triple Distilled Vodka; various international brands such as Vat69, Black & White Scotch Whiskey, Black Dog, Captain Morgan, and Smirnoff; and licensed brands, including Bagpiper Whisky, and MC Dowell No. 1 Celebration Rum. It serves household and commercial customers. Associated Alcohols & Breweries Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Indore, India.

name: Ashapura Minechem Limited
summary: Ashapura Minechem Limited is involved in the mining, manufacturing, and trading of various minerals and its derivative products in India and internationally. The company offers processed bentonite products for foundry, iron ore pelletising, civil engineering, pet litter, environmental containment, and animal feed applications; bentonite-based drilling fluids and specialty additives to the oil and gas exploration sector; bleaching earth used for the removal of pigments, oxidation products, and other contaminants from crude vegetable oils; calcined China clay (CCC) and ground calcium carbonate (GCC) primarily from kaolin raw materials, with broad applications in paint and coatings, inks, paper, fibreglass, specialty rubber, and construction chemicals; and calcined bauxite and associated specialty grades for the steel, cement, glass, and aluminium industries, as well as exports bauxite. The company was founded in 1960 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Ashiana Housing Limited
summary: Ashiana Housing Limited, through its subsidiaries, engages in the real estate development business in India. The company develops senior living, kid centric, premium, and elite homes. It also engages in the identification and acquisition of land; planning, designing, construction, and marketing of its projects; and provision of facilities management services, including identification of third-party lessees/buyers. In addition, the company provides rental and resale services for properties. Further, it operates hotels and clubs, which include rooms, a restaurant, banquets, and other services. The company was formerly known as Ashiana Housing & Finance India Ltd and changed its name to Ashiana Housing Limited in May 2007. Ashiana Housing Limited was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in New Delhi, India.

name: Ashika Global Securities Limited
summary: Ashika Global Securities Limited provides investment and lending solutions in India. It provides loans and advances, loans against securities, inter-corporate deposits, and investment in shares and securities. The company also offers retail broking; lending; investment banking; global family office services; alternative investment funds; research advisory; institutional broking; private equity services; and insurance and insurance related services. It serves individuals, corporates, and financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Ashika Credit Capital Limited and changed its name to Ashika Global Securities Limited in January 2026. Ashika Global Securities Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Ashima Limited
summary: Ashima Limited engages in real estate business in India. It operates through Real Estate and Investment segments. The company provides portfolio management services, as well as develops residential and commercial properties. Ashima Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is based in Ahmedabad, India. Ashima Limited is a subsidiary of Navchintan Trust.

name: Ashoka Buildcon Limited
summary: Ashoka Buildcon Limited engages in the construction business in India. It operates through Construction & Contract Related Activity; Built, Operate and Transfer (BOT)/ Annuity Projects; and Sale of Goods segments. The company engages in the construction of infrastructure facilities on engineering, procurement, and construction basis, as well as built, operate, and transfer basis. It also sells ready mixed concrete; and real estate properties. It undertakes various projects, such as highways, bridges, power, buildings, solar, water, airports, and railways. Ashoka Buildcon Limited was founded in 1976 and is based in Nashik, India.

name: Ashoka Metcast Limited
summary: Ashoka Metcast Limited engages in the trading of steel, goods, and other products in India. It provides thermo-mechanically treated bars, round, mild steel, and angle bars, and steel channels. The company was incorporated in 2009 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Ashok Leyland Limited
summary: Ashok Leyland Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells commercial vehicles in India. It operates in Commercial Vehicle and Financial Service segments. The company offers ICV trucks, haulage vehicles, tractors, and tippers; buses; light commercial vehicle goods carriers and passenger vehicles, and small commercial vehicle goods carriers; defense vehicles, such as armored, high mobility, specialist, and logistics vehicles; transit mixers for use in construction and mining operations; and tanker trucks, reefers, ambulances, and other custom-built vehicles. It also provides power solutions, such as diesel gensets, agriculture and industrial non-emission and emission engines, and marine genset and propulsion engines; spare parts; forgings and castings; manpower supply, air chartering, and IT services; and vehicle and housing financing services. In addition, the company trades in commercial vehicles; and operates retail parts stores. Further, it provides at-site and e-commerce service support; AL Revive Program, which restores accident vehicles; technical and driving training; AL Care, a one-stop solution designed to take care of service needs; iAlert, a telematics solution for vehicle and fuel platforms; uptime solution centers; AL Live, which provides live location tracking of mobile service vans; Re-AL, a vehicle buying, selling, and exchange platform; and LeyKart app. The company serves various customer categories, including commercial fleet operators, retail customers, government, industrial customers, defense and military customers, and special application vehicle customers through its distributors. It also exports its products to the Middle East, Africa, South Asia, Latin America, and the Commonwealth of Independent States countries. Ashok Leyland Limited was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Chennai, India. Ashok Leyland Limited operates as a subsidiary of Hinduja Automotive Limited.

name: Asian Energy Services Limited
summary: Asian Energy Services Limited provides services to the energy, mineral, coal, and power sectors primarily in India and internationally. The company operates through Oil and Gas, and Mineral and Other Energy Sectors segments. It offers seismic services, including a national seismic program, carpet 3D, seismic WORK, 2D/3D land seismic acquisition, transition zone acquisition, on-site data processing, borehole and multiclient seismic, seismic consulting and interpretation, and wireless seismic and data acquisition in real time. The company also operates and maintains onshore and offshore oil and gas facilities; provides energy-intensive techniques, such as injection of heat, chemicals, carbon dioxide or other gases, and cyclical steam injection to extract crude; and offers material handling, exploration, mining development and operation, and other services. In addition, it provides various facilities, such as floating oil production units; floating, production, storage, and offloading; mobile oil production units; and onshore oil and gas terminals. The company was formerly known as Asian Oilfield Services Limited and changed its name to Asian Energy Services Limited in October 2020. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Mumbai, India. Asian Energy Services Limited operates as a subsidiary of Oilmax Energy Private Limited.

name: Asian Hotels (North) Limited
summary: Asian Hotels (North) Limited engages in the hospitality/hotel business in India. The company owns and operates Hyatt Regency Delhi, a five-star deluxe hotel, including rooms and suites, a spa, a unisex salon, a fitness center, restaurants, lounge bars, and an outdoor swimming pool in New Delhi. It also engages in the real estate business. Asian Hotels (North) Limited was incorporated in 1980 and is based in New Delhi, India.

name: Asian Paints Limited
summary: Asian Paints Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture, distribution, and sale of paints, coatings, and products related to home decoration and bath fittings, kitchen, and wardrobe in India, Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and the South Pacific region. The company offers wall coverings, waterproofing products, adhesives; and bath fittings and sanitaryware, modular kitchens and wardrobes, fabric, furnishings, rugs, decorative lightings, unplasticized polyvinyl chloride windows and door systems, furniture, textures and painting aids, and mechanized tools. It also provides color consultancy, projects, home painting services, waterproofing and wood solutions, and assure services; and interior and exterior wall finishes, enamels, tools, undercoats, thinners, and varnishers. The company offers its products under the Asian Paints, SCIB Paints, Apco Coatings, Asian Paints Berger, Taubmans, Asian Paints Causeway, and Kadisco Asian Paints brand names. It serves homeowners, large projects, dealers, corporates, architects, interior designers, contractors, and influencers through multi-channel distribution network comprising wholesalers, distributors, retail outlets, and e-commerce platforms. Asian Paints Limited was founded in 1942 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Asian Granito India Limited
summary: Asian Granito India Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacture and trade of tiles, marbles, and allied products in India and internationally. The company offers floor, wall, and parking tiles; glazed and polished vitrified tiles; countertops; quartz and marble surfaces; sanitary ware comprising showers, water closets, basins, urinals, cisterns, and seat covers; bath ware; CP fittings; faucets and construction chemicals. It distributes its products through a network of dealers and sub-dealers, retail touchpoints, display centers, and franchisee showrooms. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Asian Tea & Exports Limited
summary: Asian Tea & Exports Limited engages in the plantation, manufacture, trade, and export of tea in India and internationally. It offers black tea, green tea, and oolong tea in the form of leaf tea, broken tea, fannings, and dust. The company also trades in pulses, including whole pigeon and yellow peas, red lentil, urhat, green peas, and chickpeas; and various foodstuff products, such as raw cashew nuts, sugar, soyabean, sesame seeds, spices, etc., as well as rice and tea bags. The company exports its products to Africa, Kazakhstan, the Middle East, Russia, Iran, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq, Uzbekistan, Pakistan, Afghanistan, Egypt, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Germany, Kenya, Sri Lanka, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, and Japan. Asian Tea & Exports Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Kolkata, India.

name: ASK Automotive Limited
summary: ASK Automotive Limited manufactures and sells auto components for the automobile industry in India. The company offers advanced braking systems, such as brake shoe and pad, brake panel assembly, clutch plate and shoe, brake linings, disc brake pad, and brake liner. It also provides aluminum lightweighting precision solutions for two and four-wheeler and electric vehicles. In addition, the company offers front and rear brake, throttle, seat lock, fuel lid, and speedometer cable assembly products, as well as accelerator cables. It serves original equipment manufacturers. The company was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Gurugram, India.

name: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited
summary: Avio Smart Market Stack Limited provides barcoding solutions, Automatic Identification and Data Capture technologies in India and internationally. It operates through three segments: Financial Inclusion and Digital Services; Agri Supply Chain and Technologies; and Diagnostics and Healthcare. The Financial Inclusion and Digital Services segment provides access to credit and allied financial products; and rural-focused lending and financial services distribution through an established last-mile network. The Agri Supply Chain and Technologies segment develops agri commerce, trade finance, smart retail and crop advisory capabilities under Project AVIO ecosystem. The Company has entered a strategic partnership with Huwel Lifesciences Private Limited, a molecular diagnostics company developing indigenous and cost-effective diagnostic technologies. In addition, the company offers its services to banks and financial institutions. The company was formerly known as Bartronics India Limited and changed its name to Avio Smart Market Stack Limited in February 2026. Avio Smart Market Stack Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

name: Aspinwall and Company Limited
summary: Aspinwall and Company Limited engages in logistics, speciality coffee, natural fiber products, and natural rubber businesses in India, the Americas, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Logistics, Coffee, and Plantation segments. The company provides liner, custom house agency, freight forwarding, air and bulk cargo, ship agency, stevedoring, warehousing, and project and over-dimensional cargo handling services. It is also involved in the plantation, buying, processing, selling, trading, and export of coffee. In addition, the company offers entrance and corridor mats, carpets, mattings, rugs, runners, and mesh mattings; and PVC and rubber-backed natural fiber products, and jute floor-coverings and furnishings, as well as supplies natural fiber geotextiles, which are used in environment engineering to prevent soil erosion and coir pith. Further, it produces centrifuged latex and technically specified natural rubber. The company was founded in 1867 and is headquartered in Mangalore, India.

name: Assam Entrade Limited
summary: Assam Entrade Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. The company trades in shares and securities, mutual fund units, debentures, and bonds; offers loans and advances; and develops integrated residential townships. It is also involved in the real estate activities, as well as acts as a real estate agent. The company serves body corporates, individuals, and other entities. Assam Entrade Limited was founded in 1985 and is based in Kanpur, India.

name: Asian Star Company Limited
summary: Asian Star Company Limited manufactures and sells diamond jewelry worldwide. It operates through two segments, Diamonds and Jewellery. The company provides generic, certified, mine-origin programme, and special-cut diamonds. In addition, it offers cocktail, European fashion, Indian fashion, men's, petite bridals, wedding, and ceramic indulgence jewellery. Further, it provides various cut and polished diamonds, and diamond studded jewelry. The company retails diamond jewelry through its jewellery boutique. Asian Star Company Limited was founded in 1971 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Astec LifeSciences Limited
summary: Astec LifeSciences Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells agrochemical active ingredients and pharmaceutical intermediates in India. The company provides triazole fungicides for use in field crops; foliar treatment for the control of scab, powdery mildew, shot-hole, blossom blight, and rust; seed treatment for the control of seed and soil-borne diseases in cotton and maize, as well as grains, such as barley, rice, and wheat; post-harvest drench; and food additive and wood preservatives. It also provides herbicides, insecticides, and agrochemical intermediates. The company also exports its products. Further, it offers contract development and manufacturing operations. The company was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India. Astec LifeSciences Limited operates as a subsidiary of Godrej Agrovet Limited.

name: Aster DM Quality Care Limited
summary: Aster DM Quality Care Limited operates as an integrated healthcare provider in India. The company operates through Hospitals & Clinics, Labs, Wholesale Pharmacies, and Others segments. It offers comprehensive healthcare services including primary, secondary, tertiary and quaternary care in various specialty areas, including multi-specialty, cardiac sciences, OP pharmacy, anaesthesiology and others, neuro sciences, oncology, gastroenterology and integrated liver care, nephrology and urology, orthopaedics, women's health, and child adolescent health areas. The company also operates hospitals and clinics; wholesale pharmacies and optical outlets; and diagnostic labs. In addition, it provides healthcare consultancy and others services; and digital health platforms. The company offers its services and products under Aster DM, CARE Hospitals, Evercare, and KIMSHEALTH brands. Aster DM Quality Care Limited was formerly known as Aster DM Healthcare Limited and changed its name to Aster DM Quality Care Limited in July 2026. The company was founded in 1987 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

name: Astral Limited
summary: Astral Limited engages in the manufacture and marketing of pipes and fittings, water tanks, and adhesives and sealants in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Plumbing, and Paints and Adhesives. It offers plumbing pipes and fittings, sewerage and drainage pipes and fittings, agriculture pipes and fittings, cable protection system, industrial piping system, fire protection system, urban infrastructure, ancillary products, and column pipe; and roto moulding, blow moulded, loft, and anti-viral copper shield water tanks. It also provides bathware products comprising faucets, sanitarywares, cisterns, and showers; paints, such as interior and exterior emulsions, distempers, enamels, and primer and wall putty undercoats; adhesives and sealants, including epoxy, PVA, rubber, anaerobic tapes, silicone, acrylic, hybrid, instant, solvent, specialty, and industrial adhesives; specialized valves, such as compact true, single union, and industrial ball valves; construction chemicals comprising waterproofing, tile adhesives and grouts, surface protection, construction additives, and repair and rehabilitation products; and infrastructure products comprising drainage, cable protection, and PT duct systems; and specialised fittings, such as electrofusion, compression, PPR pipe fittings, integrated and mechanical clamp, integrated composite strap-on saddles, uPVC conduit fittings. The company was formerly known as Astral Poly Technik Limited and changed its name to Astral Limited in April 2021. Astral Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Astra Microwave Products Limited
summary: Astra Microwave Products Limited designs, develops, manufactures, and sells sub-systems for radio frequency and microwave systems used in defense, space, meteorology, civil, and telecommunication applications in India. It offers radar electronics, including active antenna array units, transmit receive (T/R) modules, wideband T/R modules, solid state power amplifiers, receivers, exciters, central units, antenna and electronic beam forming units, digital receivers, array group and monopulse receivers, waveform generators, and MMIC; and electronic warfare products comprising wideband and ultra-wideband subsystems, antennas, EDLVA and BLI super components, EW simulators, DIFM receivers, front end receivers, up and down convertors, and homodyne receivers. The company also provides strategic electronics and telemetry, such as command guidance units, radio proximity fuse, transponder, phased array-based telemetry tracking system, sub-systems for gimbal based and AESA seeker, and ground and air-borne data link systems; and data and video telemetry transmitters, and decoders, as well as PCM encoders, integrated telemetry transponders, auto-track antenna systems, and high-altitude proximity sensors. In addition, it offers ground-based systems consist of sub-systems for multi-object tracking radar, coherent frequency generators, modulators, switchable routers, V/UHF T/R modules, and Ka-band indoor/outdoor units; sub-systems for SAR payloads, geostationary satellites, and remote sensing satellites, as well as fabrication of flight sub-systems and screening; automatic weather stations, agromet meteorological stations, water level measurement, and automatic rain gauge, as well as avalanche, wind profile, and weather radars; global navigation satellite systems; unmanned ground vehicles; and homeland security products. The company also exports its products. Astra Microwave Products Limited was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Hyderabad, India.

name: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited
summary: AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited, a biopharmaceutical company, manufactures, markets, and trades in pharmaceutical products in India and internationally. It provides medicines for cancers, including pancreatic cancer, certain blood cancers, and cancers within breast, lung, ovary, and prostate; rare diseases; and cardiovascular, renal and metabolism, and respiratory and immunology, as well as diabetes. The company serves distributors, hospitals, and government institutions. The company was incorporated in 1979 and is based in Bengaluru, India. AstraZeneca Pharma India Limited is a subsidiary of AstraZeneca Pharmaceuticals AB.

name: Atal Realtech Limited
summary: Atal Realtech Limited, a construction company, provides integrated civil works contracting and engineering services for structural construction and infrastructure sector projects in India. The company engages in contracting and sub-contracting for various government and private projects, including the construction of commercial and industrial structures; and the provision of project management services. It also undertakes projects for private construction companies and real estate developers, as well as trades in construction materials. In addition, the company provides services for civil construction projects comprising structures, such as sports complexes, indoor and outdoor stadiums, multi-purpose halls, commercial structures, industrial structures, hospitals, cold storage, educational institution, and mass housing projects; and water supply and drainage, road and bridge, and major and minor irrigation projects. Atal Realtech Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Nashik, India.

name: Atam Valves Limited
summary: Atam Valves Limited manufactures and sells valves, fittings, steam traps, and strainers in India, Nepal, Italy, Canada, the United Kingdom, Malaysia, South Africa, Dubai, and internationally. The company offers cocks and boiler mountings; moisture separators; sight indicators; steam traps; strainers; water level gauges; fusible plugs; air, ball, butterfly, check, foot, gate, globe, needle, non-return, parallel slide blow off, plug, pressure reducing, safety, steam stop, and wheel valves gauges; drop forged stainless steel needle valve, and screwed ends; and sight flow. It serves the oil and gas refinery, petrochemical, power generation plant, boiler manufacturing, power transformer manufacturing, sugar, textile, rubber, pharmaceutical, chemical, fertilizer, paper, processing, marine and ship building, infrastructure and household, and plumbing industries. The company sells its products under the ATAM and FEBI brands through dealers. Atam Valves Limited was founded in 1972 and is based in Jalandhar, India.

name: Adani Total Gas Limited
summary: Adani Total Gas Limited engages in the city gas distribution (CGD) business in India. It supplies piped natural gas and compressed natural gas to the domestic, commercial, industrial, and transportation sectors. The company also provides biogas, biofuel, biomass, LCNG, HCNG, EV, and hydrogen. In addition, it manufactures various equipment; and offers value-added services related to the CGD business. The company was formerly known as Adani Gas Limited and changed its name to Adani Total Gas Limited in January 2021. Adani Total Gas Limited was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Ather Energy Limited
summary: Ather Energy Limited, an electric vehicle company, engages in the design, development, and sale of electric two-wheelers, and associated product ecosystem. The company also offers vehicle architecture and chassis; battery packs and battery management system; vehicle control unit; touchscreen dashboard; motor controller; transmission; signal harness; and fast charging system. In addition, it provides charging infrastructure, software, accessories and insurance policies in the capacity of corporate agent. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Bengaluru, India.

name: Allcargo Terminals Limited
summary: Allcargo Terminals Limited operates container freight stations (CFS) and logistics business in India and internationally. It provides import and export handling; bonded, non-bonded, and open warehousing; direct port delivery; hazardous cargo; cargo handling; reefer container; ISO tank; and last mile transportation services. Allcargo Terminals Limited was founded in 2003 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: Atlantaa Limited
summary: Atlantaa Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction business in India. The company undertakes development of highways, expressways, and arterial roads, as well as railway projects; and constructing airport infrastructures. It is also involved in Infrastructure development; engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) contracts; public, private partnership (PPP Model on build operate and transfer (BOT) and design, build, finance, operate and transfer (DBFOT) basis; and infrastructure development activities, such as inter-alia, construction of road, bridges, and runways. In addition, the company engages in the real estate development comprising residential, retail, and commercial. The company was formerly known as Atlanta Limited and changed its name to Atlantaa Limited in September 2023. Atlantaa Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Atlanta Electricals Limited
summary: Atlanta Electricals Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of transformers to institutional and corporate customers in India. Its products include power, auto, inverter duty, generator, furnace, and transformers. It also provides after-sales support services. The company serves transmission, steel, dairies, solar, textile, construction, and infrastructure industries. Atlanta Electricals Limited was incorporated in 1988 and is based in Anand, India.

name: Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited
summary: Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited manufactures and sells bicycles in India. The company was formerly known as Atlas Cycle Industries Ltd and changed its name to Atlas Cycles (Haryana) Limited in April 2002. The company was incorporated in 1950 and is based in Sonepat, India.

name: Atul Ltd
summary: Atul Ltd manufactures and sells chemicals and other chemical products worldwide. The company offers 2 nitro para cresol, 2-methylcyclohexyl acetate, allyl caproate and heptanoate, ambrettolide, anethole, cresol mixture, manganese sulphate monohydrate, ortho cresol and methoxy toluene, phenyl acetic acid, skatole, and sodium sulfite and sulphate, as well as anisic aldehyde, anisyl acetate and alcohol, anisyl propanal, cresidine, cresol, cresyl acetate and methyl ether, methoxy phenyl acetic acid, aceto nitrile, benzylamine hydrochloride, and 4-chloro-3-ethyl-1-methyl-1h-pyrazole-5-carboxylic acid; and bulk chemicals and intermediates, including 1,3-cyclohexanedione, 2-methylresorcinol, 4-chlororesorcinol, anisole, caustic soda lye, chlorosulphonic and hydrochloric acid, gypsum, hydrogen gas, liquid chlorine, liquid sulphur dioxide and trioxide, oleum, resoform, resorcinol, resorcinol dimethyl ether, sodium hypochlorite, sodium sulphite, and sulphuric acid. It also provides synthetic and natural food colors; biostimulants, fungicides, herbicides, and insecticides; amino acid derivatives, active pharmaceutical ingredients (API), API intermediates, and phosgene derivatives; and epoxy resins, curing agents, reactive diluents, accelerators and catalysts, formulations, and sulfones. In addition, the company produces tissue culture raised date palm plants, as well as engages in crop protection retail and polymers retail operations. It serves various industries, such as adhesives, agriculture, animal feed, aerospace and defense, automotive, composites, construction, electrical and electronics, food and beverage packaging, marine, medical device, paint and coatings, sport and leisure, transport, wind energy, cosmetics, dyestuff, flavor, footwear, fragrance, glass, home care, horticulture, hospitality, paper, personal care, pharmaceutical, plastic, polymer, rubber, soap and detergent, textile, and tire. Atul Ltd was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Valsad, India.

name: Atul Auto Limited
summary: Atul Auto Limited manufactures and sells three-wheeler automobiles in India. It operates through Automobiles Business and Non Banking Financial Business segments. The company offers cargo, passenger, and e-rickshaw vehicles, as well as spare parts and accessories. It is also involved in retail finance business. The company sells its products under the Atul RIK, Atul GEM, Atul Elite, Atul:E, Atul Shakti, and Atul Gemini+ brands. It also exports its products. Atul Auto Limited was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Rajkot, India.

name: AU Small Finance Bank Limited
summary: AU Small Finance Bank Limited provides various banking and financial services in India. The company operates through Treasury, Retail Banking, Wholesale Banking, and Other Banking Operations segments. It offers savings, NRI, corporate salary, senior citizen, women and family, minor, current, premium banking, special offerings, RERA and escrow, collection, share capital and dividend, EXIM, institution current, government banking, Forex, SNRR, and grouping of business and personal accounts; and fixed, recurring, FCNR, and green fixed deposits. The company also provides home, car, commercial vehicle and equipment, gold, personal, two-wheeler, tractor, micro business, working capital, term, commercial vehicle, and tractor loans; loan secured by vehicle, and against FD and property; supply chain finance, renewables funding, real estate funding and project finance, and NBFC and startup funding; and trade finance, such as letter of credit, bank guarantees, buyer's credit, export credit, and Forex and hedging solutions. In addition, it offers cards and payments, including debit and credit cards, ATM and micro-ATM, UPI/Scan and Pay, fund transfer, doorstep banking, international payments, bill pay, mobile recharge, FASTag, and tax payments; AU 0101 and AU 0101 Business applications; and wealth products comprising mutual funds, ASBA/IPO, PMS/AIF/Bonds, and 3-in-1 trading and demat accounts. Further, the company provides life, health, and general insurance; and locker products. It serves urban, semi-urban, and rural markets, as well as salaried and self-employed individuals, small businesses, merchants, women entrepreneurs, farmers, micro-enterprises, and emerging affluent households. The company was formerly known as AU Financiers (India) Limited and changed its name to AU Small Finance Bank Limited in May 2017. AU Small Finance Bank Limited was incorporated in 1996 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.

name: AUGMONT ENTERPRISES LTD
summary: Augmont Enterprises Limited operates as an integrated gold and silver platform in India. It engages in procurement and refining, bullion trading, digital gold offerings, jewellery manufacturing, international sales and facilitating gold-backed financial services. The company operates its enterprise sales vertical through its Augmont SPOT' platform, a fully electronic, over-the-counter delivery-based bullion platform that enables such as jewelers, bullion dealers, and manufacturers with valid GST registrations to purchase gold and silver bars online. It is also involved in the sale of gold bullion to asset management companies in exchange for units of gold exchange traded funds (ETF) and trade in gold and silver ETF units. In addition, the company manufactures and sells gold jewelry articles, which include chains to jewelry traders, as well as platinum. Further, it serves consumers through its Augmont Gold For All' platform by offering access to a range of gold and silver related services. The company's platform enables users to buy, sell, and store gold and silver digitally; purchase gold through systematic investment plans; liquidate and sell old gold; purchase coins starting from 1 gm; and avail technology support for gold loans. Augmont Enterprises Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: Auri Grow India Limited
summary: Auri Grow India Limited manufactures and sells electronic cables and conductors in India. The company provides Aluminum Conductor Steel Reinforced, conductor wire, Aluminum Alloy Conductor, and AB cables. It also offers stay, and DPC wires, as well as XLP coated wires and conductors. The company was formerly known as Godha Cabcon & Insulation Limited and change its name to Auri Grow India Limited in October 2025. Auri Grow India Limited was founded in 1987 and is based in Indore, India.

name: Aurionpro Solutions Limited
summary: Aurionpro Solutions Limited provides technology solutions in India, Asia-Pacific, and internationally. It operates through Sale of Software Services, and Sale of Equipment and Product License segments. The company offers Arya.ai, an enterprise solutions specializing in banking and financial services; and Lexi.ai to deliver accurate, true-to-model explainability, monitoring, risk management, and alignment techniques, as well as operates lexi.ai AI alignment labs. It also provides Murex Services, a managed services provide specialized capital markets solutions; Fenixys for delivering complex front-to-back transformations; FX Connect provides retail and corporate services; iCashpro a next-generation transaction banking platform; Fintra for trade & supply chain; AuroDigi, a digital banking platform for wholesale banking services; and Aurobees, an integrated supply chain and financing platforms. In addition, the company offers data center solutions and services, such as engineering, construction, products and solutions, and various support services; hybrid cloud services, including devops automation, cloud and hosting, managed cloud, monitoring, network security, server management, and helpdesk services; and integro corporate lending solutions, comprising loan origination system, financial analysis, limits management system, collateral management system, trade limit, early warning system, and document management system, smaert rules, view, capture, collect, data connect, connect risk analytics, intelligence, ESG and digital form; and consumer lending solution. Further, it offers G to G Solutions, E-governance public, and smart city services. Aurionpro Solutions Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Navi Mumbai, India.

name: Aurobindo Pharma Limited
summary: Aurobindo Pharma Limited, a pharmaceutical company, develops, manufactures, and commercializes generic pharmaceuticals in India, the United States, Europe, and internationally. The company manufactures a range of finished formulation products in various forms, such as oral solids, liquids, injectables for generic pharmaceuticals, branded specialty pharmaceuticals, and active pharmaceutical ingredients for CNS, anti-retroviral, cardiovascular, antibiotics, gastroenterology, anti-diabetics, and anti-allergic therapeutic areas. It also provides ointments, creams, gels, powders, transdermal, and lotions; antiretroviral drugs for PLHIV & CLHIV; and injectable products, including Penems, Penicillin, Cephalosporin, ophthalmic, inhalation, oncology, and hormone products. The company was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Hyderabad, India.

name: Aurum PropTech Limited
summary: Aurum PropTech Limited engages in the business of software development for real estate and other services in India. It operates through Rental, Distribution, Capital, and Others segments. The company provides HelloWorld, a co-living platform for students and young professionals; Nestaway, a home rental platform that offers residences in prime urban locations; and MonkSpaces.Ai, which enables real estate businesses to monetize and manage their rental portfolios. It also offers Aurum Analytica that delivers end-to-end solutions for the real estate lifecycle; Sell.do, a customer relationship management for real estate; Integrow Asset Management, provides investment solutions spanning institutional-quality residential and commercial real estate; PropTech Pulse, a knowledge platform for the real estate; and Aurum KuberX, a home financing AI-powered platform that connects homebuyers, developers and financial institutions. In addition, the company provides marketing, sales automation, and transaction management solutions, as well as TheHouseMonk and TheOfficeMonk, which offers property management solutions. The company was formerly known as Majesco Limited and changed its name to Aurum PropTech Limited in October 2021. Aurum PropTech Limited was incorporated in 2013 and is based in Navi Mumbai, India.

name: Aurus Gem Corporation Limited
summary: Aurus Gem Corporation Limited trades cut and polished diamonds, and diamond-studded jewellery in India and internationally. It sells its products through wholesale channels. The company was formerly known as Lypsa Gems & Jewellery Limited and changed its name to Aurus Gem Corporation Limited in May 2026. Aurus Gem Corporation Limited was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Mumbai, India.

name: AuSom Enterprise Limited
summary: AuSom Enterprise Limited operates as a trading company in India. It trades in commodities, bullions, gold jewelry, diamonds, derivatives, shares and securities, and units of mutual funds; manufactures and sells gold bars; and generates and distributes electric power through solar or wind power and other energy generation plant. The company was formerly known as Core Emballage Limited. AuSom Enterprise Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.

name: Austin Engineering Company Limited
summary: Austin Engineering Company Limited manufactures and sells bearings and its components in India and internationally. The company offers deep groove ball bearings, angular contact ball bearings, self-aligning ball bearings, thin section ball bearings, thrust ball bearings, angular contact thrust ball bearings, cylindrical roller bearings, needle roller bearings, tapered roller bearings, spherical roller bearings, flexible roller bearings, crossed roller bearings, cylindrical roller thrust bearings, tapered roller thrust bearings, spherical roller thrust bearings, and super precision bearings. Its products are used for aerospace, machine tools, mining and quarry, oil and gas, pulp and paper, pumps and motors, railroads, steel mills, transmission, and wind energy applications. The company serves engineering equipment manufacturers, steel plants and steel rolling mills, process industries, automotive industries, textile machinery manufacturers, power plants, road transport undertakings, railways, atomic energy applications, OEMs, and replacement market customers. It also exports products. Austin Engineering Company Limited was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Alpharetta, Georgia.

name: Automotive Axles Limited
summary: Automotive Axles Limited manufactures and sells automotive components in India. It offers drive axles, non-drive axles, defense axles, front steer axles, off-highway axles, drum and disc brakes, and suspension related products. The company primarily serves trucks and buses manufacturers, original equipment manufacturers, and military and off-highway vehicle sectors. It also exports its products to the United States, China, France, Italy, Brazil, Australia, and internationally. Automotive Axles Limited was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Mysore, India.

name: Autoline Industries Limited
summary: Autoline Industries Limited manufactures and sells sheet metal stampings, welded assemblies, and molds for the automotive industries in India and internationally. The company offers small mechanical assemblies, including pedal boxes, parking brakes, door hinges, cab stay and cab tilt assemblies, and battery brackets; exhaust systems; medium stamp parts/assemblies; large stamp assemblies; non-automotive assemblies; hospital beds and steel furniture; and sub-assemblies and assemblies, foot control modules, load body, tubular structures, fabrications, etc. It also provides design and engineering services, such as product engineering, product re-engineering, sheet metal-BIW design and engineering, and jigs and fixture services, as well as reverse engineering and legacy data conversion. In addition, the company offers manufacturing services comprising tool room, and prototype and mass manufacturing services, as well as contract engineering manpower for onsite and offsite deployment. Further, it provides engineering and designing software services and business solutions. Autoline Industries Limited was founded in 1995 and is based in Pune, India.

name: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited
summary: Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited manufactures and sells sugar and its by-products in India. The company operates through Sugar, Distillery, Co-generation, and Others segments. It offers molasses, bagasse, and press-mud products. In addition, the company provides industrial spirits, including ethanol and fusel oils. Further, the company is involved in generation and transmission of power, as well as trading of petroleum products. Avadh Sugar & Energy Limited was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Kolkata, India.

name: Avalon Technologies Limited
summary: Avalon Technologies Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides integrated electronic manufacturing services in India, the United States, and internationally. It offers printed circuit board assemblies; custom cables and wire harness assemblies; magnetic assemblies; sheet metal fabrication and assemblies, as well as contract services; aerospace sheet metal fabrication; precision injection molding for plastic parts; new product introduction, including prototype building services; design for manufacturing implementation; product engineering; volume production; life cycle management; system integration; machining; and supply chain and logistics.
